P1_capability_parity.finding: qualification F built the provider with 'openai_compatible', but the frozen configuration specifies 'openrouter' — a different capability path (openrouter -> OpenAICompatibleStructuredProvider: multi-turn AND structured-output; openai_compatible -> single-turn only). Worse, the v2 Proxy returned wrappedMultiTurn/wrappedComplete whenever those property names were requested, REGARDLESS of inner-provider capability — manufacturing capabilities the inner provider lacks.
P1_capability_parity.correction_wrapper: the Proxy now overrides complete/completeMultiTurn ONLY when the inner provider genuinely implements them (typeof check on the target); an absent capability stays absent through the wrapper. Capability probing by presence remains honest — the same discipline DynamicLLMProvider itself applies.
P1_capability_parity.correction_qualification: qualification F now resolves the provider with the EXACT frozen configuration (provider 'openrouter', base_url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, model z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, api_key_env OPENROUTER_API_KEY) via resolveLLMProvider() and verifies presence/absence/behavior: presence truth {complete:true, completeMultiTurn:true, completeStructured:true} on the frozen-resolution provider (DynamicLLMProvider over OpenAICompatibleStructuredProvider); all three present through the wrapper (overrides + ORIGINAL completeStructured reference); ABSENCE parity proven with an openai_compatible provider (lacks completeMultiTurn/completeStructured -> wrapper exposes NEITHER, while the present complete stays wrapped).

P1_dual_failure_surfacings.finding: on a failed provider request, a failure to write the error record was silently swallowed (original error rethrown only) — contradicting addendum 4's fail-closed policy and hiding a capture-integrity failure, which matters because P2 has an explicit infrastructure-censoring taxonomy
P1_dual_failure_surfacings.correction_wrapper: the dual-failure path now throws: 'wire-capture: evidence-integrity failure — the provider request failed (<original provider error>) and its error record could not be archived (<write error>); capture-integrity STOP' — the original provider error is preserved as the cause, and the capture-integrity failure SURFACES
P1_dual_failure_surfacings.effective_stop_classification: a 'wire-capture: evidence-integrity failure' surfacing in a live run is an EVIDENCE-INTEGRITY STOP (S2 class): the campaign halts and returns to the operator. It is NEVER recorded as an ordinary censored provider outcome, never treated as transport/infra censoring, and never silently absorbed into the abort taxonomy
P1_dual_failure_surfacings.qualification_G: provider 503 injected together with sabotage of the capture target between the request record and the error record -> the dual-failure error surfaces with all three properties verified (marker, provider cause preserved, capture-integrity STOP classification); the observed failure class also proves the request record was archived before the sabotage (a request-phase write failure would have thrown the plain pre-call marker instead)
